To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the developed model enables energy estimation within early system design phases, that it is applicable for networked embedded systems and that the execution time estimation technique is applicable for embedded systems.
the developed energy model enables an estimation of energy consumption of embedded system resulted by concurrent software.
we have presented and evaluated a new approach to model the energy consumption of networked embedded systems resulted by software components.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new energy model which is applicable during early phases of embedded system design.
the development of a model for early estimation of energy consumption of embedded software components.
the early energy estimation of networked embedded systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the presented energy estimation model is applicable early within the system development process and can be utilized to estimate the energy consumption of embedded system resulted by concurrent software.
the model and the presented methods are suitable for the intended use.

the presented approach is a first step towards an energy estimation of networked embedded systems which is applicable early in the system design process and enables system designers to estimate the energy consumption of networked embedded system early in the development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
energy estimation of embedded systems is possible within early development phases, using existing methods and only available information.
a model for energy estimation of networked embedded systems is presented which can be applied within the early development phases of such systems.

the model is capable to estimate the energy consumption of a networked embedded system early in the development phase, and that the estimation of execution times of software components is a valuable contribution to that.
The main takeaway from our work is that
energy estimation is possible in early phases of system architecture design.
the presented model enables the energy estimation of networked embedded systems during early phases of development, and thus allows to compare different allocations within a system.
the presented model is a first step towards an energy estimation of networked embedded systems.
